item.title: Kitten rescued from excavator gets tiny hard hat
item.description: An Ohio man discovered a kitten in need while checking his construction equipment, leading to a rescue and a miniature hard hat for the feline.

item.title: At least 65 Americans missing in Nepal-Tibet floods, officials report
item.description: Rescue operations continue after flash floods in the Nepal-Tibet border region killed at least 273 people, with dozens of Americans still unaccounted for.

item.title: Iran war's length could sway midterm elections for Republicans
item.description: The prolonged conflict with Iran is influencing the upcoming midterm elections, challenging Republican expectations.

item.title: Iran and Oman reach Strait of Hormuz deal, pressuring U.S. response
item.description: Amid U.S. sanctions, Iran announces an agreement with Oman to facilitate shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, shifting the onus to Washington.
